# Check — M0-a-15, the arena block: closing check of hardening round S1 (lane check/M0-a-15-close-s1, flow-7, 2026-10-14)

**Verdict: PASS.** This checker re-read every source note and inventory row of the round and re-ran each one's evidence
itself. Every FIX-NOW row is fixed or pinned. The two rows the round REPORTED (note 9 and queue L16) carry a stated
reason that holds: each fix needs another item's file, and L16 also needs a contract change. Neither is a failing
line. No new finding is a blocker.

* **Pins.** 31 targeted mutants ran in this checker's own mirror. 28 are red, and they include every pin's own mutant:
  M2a – c, M3, M5, M6a – c, M7a – b, M11, M12 / M12c and K12. Three survive, and this checker judges each one
  equivalent or outside the stated promise (X3a, X6b3, M12b; notes N-s1c-1 to N-s1c-3).
* **Behaviour.** No source behaviour moved. Main's head `a000282` differs from the tree in exactly the record's eight
  files. `decode.ts`'s code lines are identical with the comments stripped.
* **Refusals.** Lawful refusals of the registered families are 0 before and 0 after. On main's eight files in the
  mirror, NEAR gave 127 / 127. In the tree it gives 132 / 132.
* **Gates.** install, lint (probe-red ok), build and landed:verify each exit 0. NEAR gives 10 files, 132 / 132, at the
  PR size. RELATED@1000 gives 402 files, 5 257 / 5 257, exit 0.

Seat: closing checker, independent of the author (`build/M0-a-15-fix-s1`, L-0542 in this tree). The lane log had
CHECKPOINT lines for this exact lane key from 03:26 to 05:04 and no LANDED line. This seat resumed at 06:21 under the
CONTINUE RULE. On this machine, the lane's mirror, its receipts (`out/`) and the finished RELATED run's done-file were
all present. The resumed seat:

* checked that the mirror equals the tree on every io source, every io test and `test/tx/fuzzgen.ts` (`cmp`);
* read the RELATED verdict from its log;
* ran the two pending demotion-pin mutants;
* re-ran install, lint, build and landed:verify in the tree;
* re-diffed the before-image.

The lane's earlier part planned its probes and mutants before it read the author's "Hardening round S1" section.
That section is judged here, not used as evidence.

Machine: `linux:Intel(R) Xeon(R) Processor @ 2.10GHz:4cpu:16gib` (the J198 id matches). Node v24.12.0.
`tools/test_budget.py` printed 1, and `--mutants` printed 1. One test process ran at a time. No timing was taken or

## Method

* **The before-image.** The checker fetched main's head `a000282` read-only through the GitHub contents API (no git):
  the item's 19 io sources and tests, and the id columns of `CLEAN-ROOM.md` and `choices.md`. These are in
  `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-15/{before,main}`.
  * Against the tree, exactly the record's 8 files differ: `kernel/src/io/decode.ts`,
    `kernel/test/io/{support.ts,digests.test.ts,roundtrip.test.ts,corrupt.test.ts}` and
    `testkit/test/kernel/io/{support.ts,constructive.test.ts,city.test.ts}`.
  * `decode.ts`, with comment lines stripped on both sides, diffs empty: "decode.ts code lines identical".
* **The mirror.** One whole copy of `plat/` (no `node_modules`), installed `--frozen-lockfile --offline`, at
  `scratchpad/waves/check-M0-a-15/mirror`. It has no absolute symlink into the tree.
  * Each mutant was an exact-string replace (the replaced string unique in its file). Each ran its pin's test file
    with `--maxWorkers=1 --bail=1`. Each file was restored from its saved bytes and byte-compared.
  * The script is `mutants.py`, and the logs are `out/*.log`.
  * At the end, the mirror equals the tree on every io source, every io test and `test/tx/fuzzgen.ts`.
* **The before-census.** Main's eight files swapped into the mirror gave NEAR "Test Files 10 passed (10) / Tests 127
  passed (127)". The round's files gave "Tests 132 passed (132)". Lawful refusals: 0 → 0 (every `load` in those files
  throws on a refusal).

## (3) New findings: none is a blocker

The checker re-checked the blocker classes, and none applies:

* Every gate exits 0.
* The item's listed interfaces and tests are present. The io exports are untouched: `io/index.ts` is byte-identical
  to `a000282`, and the barrel `src/index.ts` is not among the round's files.
* No stub or shortcut was added. The two REPORTED rows leave the code as it was, and each is routed with a stated
  reason.
* There is no wrong result on an honest input: no source behaviour moved.
* No path outside `plat/` was changed except the lane log.
* There was no clean-room breach.

The author's round section agrees with this checker's evidence, apart from two points. First, it numbers one mutant
M12a, which is this checker's M12c. Second, it records N-s1-2, a read-only `git status` the builder ran by mistake. That
command changed no state, and this checker leaves it to the session.

Eight notes rows, N-s1c-1 to N-s1c-8, go to `checks/M0-a-15-notes.md` under "Closing check of hardening round S1":

* three equivalence judgements;
* one title tightening;
* row 12's history;
* the C-0367 / L-0542 id collision with main, for the session;
* the open routings of L16 and note 9.

They are recorded as `check-M0-a-15-notes` under this lane.
